items.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
items.summary: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. items.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
items.summary: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. items.title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
items.summary: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. items.title: Transferring the Intelligence of VLMs to Robotic Control
items.summary: Humans can seamlessly adapt to both physical and digital worlds, suggesting that while a digital-to-real gap exists in embodiment, environment and task, human intelligence itself may transfer across this gap. items.title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
items.summary: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems over enterprise knowledge bases must ingest heterogeneous document formats -- PDFs, Word documents, presentations, and scans -- whose content is locked inside complex visual layouts, multi-column pages, and dense tables. items.title: VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents
items.summary: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. items.title: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
items.summary: We define OmniVChat (Omni Video Chat) as the task of native audio-visual dialogue between a user and an omni model. In OmniVChat, omni models directly and simultaneously receive audio and video from a user and return text. items.title: Designer-RSI: Evolving Procedural Memory from User Traffic for Agentic Graphic Design
items.summary: Professional graphic design is a long-horizon agentic task in which structured, editable artifacts emerge from many interdependent actions, yet outcomes admit no reliable programmatic oracle. items.summary: Manipulation policies must know which objects matter and where they are, yet the pretrained backbones that current robot foundation models build on, from language in vision-language-action models (VLAs) to video generation in world-action models (WAMs), do not directly require this metric grounding, leaving it to be learned implicitly from robot demonstrations. items.title: HuRo: Robotizing Human Videos for Scalable VLA Pretraining
items.summary: Human video datasets offer an abundant and diverse source of interaction data that can complement expensive real-robot data. items.summary: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. items.title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Towards Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
items.summary: Business intelligence (BI) is a cornerstone of enterprise decision-making and is widely used by enterprise users in software such as Power BI and Tableau. In traditional BI workflows, users need to prepare data by (1) identifying relevant tables, (2) performing data transformations, and (3) building join relationships, before they can (4) answer their business questions. items.title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
items.summary: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. items.title: Harness-Zero: Harness Distillation via Agent-as-Harness
items.summary: Agent harnesses, the external systems that mediate model-environment interaction, can substantially improve agent performance, but their gains remain tied to the harness at deployment. items.title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
items.summary: Natural interaction in digital and physical environments requires continuous perception and timely responses. Spoken dialogue relies on acoustic and linguistic cues, while video interaction also requires grounding the conversation in evolving visual context. items.title: CARE: Experience-Guided Atomic Corrective Execution for Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain brittle once execution deviates from nominal trajectories. items.title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
items.summary: Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. items.title: Why Do Video Diffusion Models Violate Physics? Unveiling the Flaws in Attention Mechanisms
items.summary: Despite impressive visual quality, state-of-the-art video diffusion models often generate content that violates real-world physical laws. items.title: Gricea: An Open Science Platform for Conversational AI Research
items.summary: We need studies on conversational AI (CAI) at scale to understand human behavior and shape CAI design. However, fragmented reporting of systems and study configurations hinders replication, extension, and knowledge accumulation. items.summary: Sparse on-policy distillation (OPD) allocates teacher supervision to a small subset of tokens in student-generated trajectories.
